# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-15 from the 2026-11-15 Hub dump.

- 3,236,190 models tracked, 931,743 declare a base model, 965,080 parent links, 92,357 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
